Dear List
I have come through the website (www.yousendit.com)the site enables sending=
very big attachments (upto 1GB) over the internet. The more interesting th=
ing that theses attachments are not uploaded to the reciepient inbox and th=
us causing inconvenient runout of space. Instead a simple mail is sent to t=

I think this is a good solution around the obstacle of sending large attach=

ies.=20
Hope it is helpful.
